title: Zamenski transformatori i stanice | Energoizgradnja Niš

copy: Tokom remonta vašeg transformatora ili stanice moguće je koristiti zamenski transformator ili kompletnu zamensku transformatorsku stanicu. Koristimo sopstvenu logistiku i vozila.
While your transformer or substation is under repair, you can use a replacement transformer or a complete replacement substation. We use our own logistics and vehicles.
highlights: 250, 400, 630, 1000 i 1600 kVA; 2 × 630 kVA za paralelan rad; 2500 kVA naponskog nivoa 35 kV. Prilagođavanje na lokaciji.
250, 400, 630, 1000 and 1600 kVA; 2 × 630 kVA for parallel operation; 2500 kVA rated at 35 kV. On-site adaptation.

name: Ispitivanje i preventivno održavanje
Testing and preventive maintenance
heading: Ispitivanje i preventivno održavanje transformatora i transformatorskih stanica
Transformer and substation testing and preventive maintenance
title: Ispitivanje transformatora | Energoizgradnja Niš
Transformer testing | Energoizgradnja, Niš
copy: Merenja, ispitivanja, pregledi, revizije, termovizijski pregledi, čišćenje i preventivno održavanje transformatora i transformatorskih stanica. Najava isključenja kod lokalne distribucije i izdavanje izveštaja i ispitnih listova.

Measurements, testing, inspections, detailed checks, thermal imaging, cleaning and preventive maintenance of transformers and substations. Outage notices to the local distribution company, reports and test certificates.
highlights: Na lokaciji: otpornost namotaja, prenosni odnos, sprežni broj i ispitivanje ulja. Pregledi i revizije 24/365.
On site: winding resistance, transformation ratio, vector group and oil testing. Inspections and detailed checks 24/365.

Transformer and substation repair
title: Remont transformatora i stanica | Energoizgradnja Niš
Transformer and substation repair | Energoizgradnja
copy: Remont energetskih dvonamotajnih, tronamotajnih i višenamotajnih transformatora i remont transformatorskih stanica. Specijalizovani smo za remont energetskih i specijalnih transformatora zaključno sa 35 kV.
Repair of two-winding, three-winding and multi-winding power transformers, as well as substations. We specialise in repairing power and special-purpose transformers rated up to and including 35 kV.
highlights: Detaljno merenje i ispitivanje transformatora u radionici pre remonta. Više sprega u jednom transformatoru i regulacija napona pod opterećenjem.
Detailed workshop measurements and tests before transformer repair. Multiple vector groups in one transformer and on-load voltage regulation.
